meta.title: 成年人不要做选择，全都要
meta.title_en: Adults Don't Choose — Take It All

scenes.title_cn: 跳槽没那么简单：成年人全都要
scenes.title_en: Why job-hopping isn't the first choice: adults take it all
scenes.context: 讲者开场抛出观点：跳槽是加薪最快的方法，但跳槽有成本，面试、找工作都不容易，就像清华北大不是想去就能去。所以成年人不要做选择，要全都要。
sentences: 成年人不要做选择，成年人全都要。
Adults don't make choices — adults take it all.
全都要：take it all
跳槽是加薪涨得最多最快的方法，但跳槽也有成本。
Job-hopping is the fastest way to grow your pay, but it comes at a cost.
涨薪最快：grow your pay fastest
如果能拿到清华北大的毕业证，谁会不去？因为你考不上啊。
If I could get a diploma from Tsinghua or Peking, why wouldn't I? Because I can't get in.
考不上：can't get in
paraphrase: 想跳就跳 → 其实跳槽有成本
Job-hopping isn't a free move — it comes with real costs.
It's not either-or — it's taking both.
scenes.speak: Now, adults don't make choices — adults take it all. Sure, job-hopping is the fastest way to grow your pay, but it comes at a cost. Think of it this way: if I could get a diploma from Tsinghua or Peking, why wouldn't I? Because I can't get in. Exactly.

scenes.title_cn: 在职全力拼，对外保持开放
scenes.title_en: Go all-in at work, and stay open to the market
scenes.context: 讲者给出核心做法：在公司里100%努力、拿A拿涨薪，同时每隔一两年对外试机会，和猎头保持关系。跟猎头聊不代表要走，而是为了知道市场对自己的定价和岗位的稀缺性。
sentences: 我在公司里100%努力地工作，要拿A，要拿涨薪。
I give 100% at work — I chase top ratings and aim for raises.
拿A拿涨薪：chase top ratings and aim for raises
同时每隔一两年，我也在外面试试看有没有新的机会。
Meanwhile, every year or two, I test the waters outside for new opportunities.
试试看：test the waters
和猎头聊一聊，不是我要走，而是想知道市场对我的定价。
Talking to headhunters isn't about leaving — it's about learning what the market prices me at.
市场定价：what the market prices me at
paraphrase: 在职卖力 → 不代表放弃对外机会
Working hard doesn't mean staying blind to outside options.
聊一聊 ≠ 要跳槽 → 校准市场定价
A casual chat isn't a resignation — it's a price check.
scenes.speak: At work, I give 100% — I chase top ratings and aim for raises. But meanwhile, every year or two, I also test the waters outside for new opportunities. And here's the thing: talking to headhunters isn't about leaving — it's about learning what the market prices me at.

scenes.title_cn: 职业经理人的价值交换与契约精神
scenes.title_en: A professional manager's deal: value for value
scenes.context: 讲者解释为何不怕公司猜疑：所有高管都跟猎头聊过，职业经理人去哪都能打工。公司想留人就得给股份、股权、高薪，他就100%到120%拼命干。商业上讲究契约精神：签了合同就全力以赴，但别拦着他对外聊机会——这就是「既要又要」。
sentences: 所有的高管都跟猎头聊过，我只是个职业经理人，去哪都能打工。
Every executive has talked to headhunters — I'm just a professional manager who can work anywhere.
职业经理人：professional manager
公司想留我，就给我股份、股权、高薪，我就拼命干。
If your company wants to keep me, give me equity, stock options, and top pay — and I'll work my heart out.
拼命干：work my heart out
签了合同我就全力以赴，但别拦着我和猎头聊，这叫既要又要。
Once I sign a contract I give it my all, but don't stop me from talking to headhunters — that's having both.
既要又要：having both
paraphrase: 公司担心我走 → 我有市场定价权
Companies fear losing me, but I hold the market price.
忠诚 vs 契约 → 契约更实在
Loyalty is nice, but a contract is concrete.
scenes.speak: And honestly, every executive has talked to headhunters — I'm just a professional manager who can work anywhere. So if your company wants to keep me, give me equity, stock options, and top pay — and I'll work my heart out. Once I sign a contract, I give it my all, but don't stop me from talking to headhunters — that's what I mean by having both.

scenes.title_cn: 跳槽的理性账本与认知
scenes.title_en: Do the math before you hop, and know yourself
scenes.context: 讲者提醒别只看表面高薪：税后没多少，还要看长期发展阶段。有些小公司恶意开高薪，半年一年就没了，跳过去最多拿两个月，下一家不接盘就「掉地上」。核心不是简单的二选一，而是把职场、公司、职业操守想清楚，再按部就班地做选择。
sentences: 别看到加两千块就想去，税一扣完没剩多少。
Don't jump just because a company offers two thousand more — after tax, there's little left.
税一扣完：after tax
有些小公司恶意开高薪，最多撑半年一年就没了。
Some small firms inflate salaries to poach you, then vanish within a year.
恶意开高薪：inflate salaries to poach
这不是简单的二选一，把职场和职业操守想清楚，再做选择。
It's not a simple either-or — think through the workplace and professional ethics before you choose.
职业操守：professional ethics
paraphrase: 高薪诱惑 → 先算算税后到手
Tempting offers shrink once you do the tax math.
意气用事 → 想清楚再行动
Decide with a clear head, not on impulse.
scenes.speak: Don't jump just because a company offers two thousand more — after tax, there's little left. Some small firms inflate salaries to poach you, then vanish within a year. And at the end of the day, this isn't a simple either-or; think through the workplace and professional ethics before you choose.

practice: Adults don't choose — they take it all.
Every year or two, I test the waters for new opportunities.
Give me equity and top pay, and I'll work my heart out for you.
Think it through before you make a move — don't decide on impulse.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：Job-hopping is the method that raises salary the most and fastest.
✓ 地道说法：Job-hopping is the fastest way to get a raise.
「涨薪最多最快的方法」别直译成 most and fastest，用 the fastest way to get a raise 更符合英语习惯。
✕ 直译腔：I am open to chat with them.
✓ 地道说法：I keep an open door and stay in touch with headhunters.
「开放的、聊一聊」口语里用 keep an open door / stay in touch 更自然，chat 太随意。
✕ 直译腔：Give me stock, give me equity, give me high salary, I will fight for you.
✓ 地道说法：Give me equity and top pay, and I'll work my heart out for you.
「拼命打/干」直译成 fight 太生硬，work my heart out 或 give it my all 才是地道的拼命干活。
✕ 直译腔：After the tax is deducted, there is not much left.
✓ 地道说法：After tax, there's barely anything left.
「税一扣完没多少了」用 after tax 做时间状语开头更简洁，deduct 书面化太重。
shifts: 跳槽 = 换份工作，是唯一的涨薪出路
跳槽 = 一笔成本与收益都要算清楚的账
跟猎头聊天 = 想跳槽，会被公司猜疑
跟猎头聊天 = 了解市场对自己的定价，是对职业的清醒
选择只能二选一：要么留下，要么跳走
不要二选一：在职拼命干 + 对外保持开放，成年人全都要
footer_notes: ASR 专有名词已按语境校正（如「掌心」校正为「涨薪」、「外援」校正为「挖人」）。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
